Ranked defects & suggested fixes

#DefectWhere (file:line)Mechanism / evidenceSuggested fix (not applied)
1Runway width never built: road is 7 m half-width on the whole lap; the 'runway' is fake slabs on one sidejs/circuits/anderstorp.js:30 (baseHW 7, no hwZones); scenery :662-696 (apron groundPatch/seatBox on side +1 only)Measured hw=7.00 at every node. Scenery paints a car-park beside a normal road, so the one identifying feature (brief §6) reads as a flat grey card field.Add def.hwZones over the runway span (control-index fractions, docs/SCENERY-API.md:32-47), e.g. hw ≈ 10-11 m, ease ~0.02; then shrink/shift the side apron to match. Def change = new-track/parent territory.
2Forest is sparse, bright and low-poly, not 'dense dark Scots pine'scenery :224-264 (h>0.18 culls, every(11)), :232 (no pine on runway sides at all); PINE colours :52-58Frames show open lawns with scattered bright-green pines; far side of runway has almost no treeline. Authored colours are dark (0.09-0.13) yet render saturated green — likely the baked PBR albedo×2.0 blend (AGENTS.md 'Baked asset pack') — hypothesis, not tested.A/B with __apex.matTex(0); if confirmed, darken PINE_* ~0.5× or tint via fz.fol; raise density (every(7)) and add a thin far treeline on the runway side (:824-832 is skipped visually).
3Pale-grey sand run-off absent; verge is tan cracked dirt along the whole lapscenery runoffApron/groundPatch(SAND) :423-424, :575-576, :882-883, :911-913; SAND :68Brief §2: sand is pale grey, not golden. Every frame shows tan/orange dirt with crack texture; the grey SAND patches are not visible as such. At night the pools glow orange on it.Trace which layer paints the tan (terrain verge material for theme green vs runoffApron); set the verge albedo/theme override or put SAND under the verge.
4Sky/horizon: saturated blue band and hard flat terrain edgedef pal :33-44 (zenith .38/.48/.60); terrainOuter :32Rendered sky is vivid blue and the green plane ends in a straight edge, most obvious at 0.50/0.83. Contradicts 'cool, blue-shifted northern light'. Overcast and fog barely change it.Check lighting preset for anderstorp (js/lighting/presets.js); soften horizon colour / fog; extend terrain or fade it to haze. Uncertain which layer owns the blue.
5Weather response weak by day, hard at nightengine (not circuit-specific); fogDensity :41 (def)Overcast ≈ dry; fog is patchy blobs, not uniform; rain/storm turn the ground near-black brown; night pines go to black and background is a void.Out of this circuit's files — report to lighting-tuner; note the day-wet-lighting branch merged here already darkens rain.
6Blank wall landmarks dominate S/F viewsscenery :301-320 (press stand, 5 rows 12 m high), :365 race control (14 wide × 9 high × 34 long), frame 01/07From trackside side +1 the camera stares at a featureless grey wall; the long grey slab (left in 01) is the pit/paddock roof block.Add windows/rake detail or lower the press stand; keep camera clearing (shot.mjs 'clear' guard did not trigger).

Not captured / uncertain

  • Not captured: rain/night at lap fractions 0.17/0.5/0.83 (dusk, night, dawn limited to 0 / 0.33 / 0.67); dawn rain; eye/trackside cameras in fog/rain/night; night trackside; a second renderer (GLX/WGX) — only TLX under SwiftShader; the pit lane and the bog water band were not framed deliberately.
  • Uncertain: why the verge is tan, why pines render bright, where the blue sky comes from, and where the night lamps come from — each is a hypothesis above, not verified. Lamp/lamp:none and orange pools are visible in frames only.
  • Corner direction labels follow the repo's +k = LEFT convention; radii are measured on the built line but 'turn names' are brief claims.
  • Real-world facts (runway size, 8 turns, historical pits) are from the brief's cited sources, not re-fetched.
  • Frames are 1280×720 q85 originals in artifacts/shots/tracks/anderstorp/; this page embeds 640 px recompressions.
